answer.text:
Intel Foundry external revenue fell **about 59.6%** in 2024 versus 2023:

\[
\frac{\$953\text{ million} - \$385\text{ million}}{\$953\text{ million}} \times 100
= 59.6\%
\]

That is a **$568 million** decrease, reported as **60%**. Intel attributed it primarily to **lower traditional packaging services revenue and lower equipment sales**.

**Source:** Intel 2024 Form 10-K, accession **0000050863-25-000009**, *Filing Summary*, chunk **12** (Intel Foundry external revenue amounts and causes); chunk **0** (reported percentage and causes).
